text:
maria_pm: Starting PRD intake — Tenant Priority Signals.

maria_pm: Problem: shared Dedicated customers report noisy tenants causing tail latency spikes; customers want per-tenant priority/weighting to protect critical business flows.

maria_pm: Goals:
- Allow operators to assign priority weights per tenant (0-100).
- Enforce lightweight, real-time prioritization in the router with minimal added latency.
- Provide observability (per-tenant QPS, p50/p95/p99, dropped requests) and per-tenant SLA filters.

maria_pm: Non-goals:
- This is NOT a full quota/billing system.
- No per-tenant model-level overrides in v1.

maria_pm: Success metrics:
- Top-10 tenants' p99 latency decreases by >=30% under contention.
- Platform-wide p99 increases <= 5% when priority enforcement enabled.
- Customer-reported incidents tied to noisy tenants drop by 50% within 3 months.

maria_pm: Asks: please propose acceptance criteria, edge cases, rollout plan, and rough dev + infra estimates by EOD Wed.

jun_eng: Ack. I'll draft acceptance criteria and a minimal router implementation sketch.

sarah_design: UX: need small console UI to set weights and view impact. Suggest an "apply to tenant" modal and per-tenant historical view. Will sketch tomorrow.

akshay_eng: Runtime concerns: must avoid per-request DB lookups. Suggest a cached config with TTL + consistent hashing to keep routing fast. If weight=0 treat as background priority.

priya_qa: Quick test cases:
- High-noise tenant spikes: critical tenant p99 stays within target.
- Weight updates take effect within X seconds.
- Behavior when config TTL expires.
- Edge: tenant not found -> default weight.

jun_eng: Draft acceptance criteria (v1):
```
AC-1: Operators can set weight (0-100) for any tenant via API/Console.
AC-2: Router honors weights and schedules tokens so higher-weight tenants receive proportionally more requests under load.
AC-3: No more than +5ms median extra latency for best-effort paths when priority enabled.
AC-4: Metrics exposed per-tenant (qps, p50/p95/p99, dropped).
AC-5: Config changes propagate to all router instances within 60s.
```

akshay_eng: +1 but open question: how do we handle tenants with bursty traffic that temporarily saturate a GPU? Propose soft cap + token bucket per-tenant.

maria_pm: Good point. Also need rollout criteria and fallback: if enforcement causes >5% platform p99 regression in canary, rollback automatically.

jun_eng: Rollout plan: canary on Dedicated pool A (10% traffic) -> monitor key metrics for 24h -> expand to 50% -> full. Add automatic kill switch tied to SLO regression.

priya_qa: Edge-case: tenant IDs with malformed chars -> should reject at API level; test for Unicode/escape sequences.

sarah_design: Will mock console modal and add small tooltip explaining "weight" semantics.

prod-bot: Spec created and linked: http://go/specs/tenant-priority-signals (internal)

maria_pm: Thanks all — I'll consolidate ACs and post a short RFC tomorrow. Ping me for questions. :thumbsup:
